archive.run.description: Archive the run via `livespec goal archive` and prove archive.run with the artifact path

dod.048.tree_validation_executed_and_rep.description: Tree validation executed and reported (or skipped by --skip-tree)

dod.055.convention_compliance_checked_ag.description: Convention Compliance checked against `.conventions/index.md` + selected `ai-ressources/` sources, or a `convention gap` explains why it could not run

dod.057.if_fix_fix_sub_agent_goals_execu.description: If `--fix`: fix sub-agent goals executed, re-check sub-agent goals executed, child goal state files inspected, and remaining gaps are warnings or canonical BLOCKED

fix.child_goal.capture.description: Capture child `/spec-fix` goal hash, contract-file path, state-file path, final status, changed files, and gap closure summary

fix.child_goal.inspect.description: Inspect child goal state files and require both fix and re-check child goals to be completed or explicitly BLOCKED

fix.child_goal.spec_check.description: Spawn independent native sub-agent to re-run `/spec-check <feature>` after each fix attempt

fix.child_goal.spec_fix.description: Spawn independent native sub-agent to execute `/spec-fix <feature> --auto --update` for each feature with fixable gaps

penflow.compare_report.description: Read penflow/compare-report.json, review-report.md, fix-report.md when present

penflow.drift.description: Classify fixable gaps across tree/spec quality, FR/AC mapping, missing or blocked tests, visual fidelity, absent or stale baseline manifests, Penflow drift, changelog/report drift, and README sync

task.001.read_before_check_hooks_all_3_l.description: Read before-check hooks (all 3 levels: global, project, local)

task.004.render_and_save_goal_contract_v.description: Render and save goal contract via `livespec goal render spec-check --save`

task.005.emit_goal_slash_command_with_ha.description: Emit `/goal` slash command with hash and contract/state file references

task.006.validate_system_files_presence_.description: Validate system files presence in .specs/ (spec-system.md, constitution.md, project.md, README.md, changelog.md, stacks/_default.md, testing/strategy.md, ADRs)

task.007.validate_feature_directory_nami.description: Validate feature directory naming pattern from `system/identity.md` (`^\d{3}(\.\d+)?-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`)

task.008.check_feature_completeness_spec.description: Check feature completeness (spec.md, changelog.md, implementation.md, plan.md per status)

task.009.detect_orphan_files_directly_un.description: Detect orphan files directly under features/

task.010.verify_readme_md_features_table.description: Verify README.md features table sync vs disk

task.011.detect_surface_drift_validate_s.description: Detect surface drift: validate surfaces.yaml vs filesystem, scan for unconfigured app directories

task.012.if_no_argument_list_features_so.description: If no argument: list features sorted by last-modified date and prompt for selection

task.013.resolve_feature_argument_git_br.description: Resolve feature: argument → git branch → interactive selection

task.014.evaluate_spec_md_quality_gates_.description: Evaluate spec.md quality gates (Gherkin, Mermaid flowcharts, AC format, FR→AC mapping, clarification markers)

task.015.evaluate_plan_md_quality_gates_.description: Evaluate plan.md quality gates if file exists (sequence/state/ER diagrams, constitution check, FR coverage)

task.016.check_implementation_quality_ga.description: Check implementation quality gates (implementation.md, changelog.md, progress.md)

task.017.read_spec_requirements_extract_.description: Read spec requirements: extract all AC, FR, SC from spec.md

task.018.read_implementation_map_from_im.description: Read implementation map from implementation.md (FR/@spec anchors, AC/test mappings, visual baselines)

task.019.recovery_mode_if_implementation.description: Recovery mode if implementation.md absent: grep @spec anchors, infer AC coverage, mark as ~ Inferred

task.020.verify_each_fr_ac_against_actua.description: Verify each FR/AC against actual code: assign ✅ Verified / ⚠️ Partial / ❌ Missing / 🔄 Drifted

task.021.load_conventions_index_md_when_.description: Load `.conventions/index.md` when present, resolve selected `ai-ressources/` files, and check Convention Compliance for mapped source/test files

task.022.report_missing_convention_bundl.description: Report missing convention bundle or violated rules as `convention gap` entries

task.024.in_ui_implementation_closure_au.description: In UI implementation closure audits, revalidate `livespec penflow-contract status --project . --required-profile implementation --build-manifest <runner_build_manifest> --feature <feature_slug> --json`; preparation/pre-impl uses `livespec penflow-contract status --project . --json` and reports readiness only

task.028.check_theme_token_compliance_if.description: Check theme token compliance if .specs/design/theme.css exists

task.030.submit_only_visual_evidence_rec.description: Submit only `{"visual_evidence_receipt_path":"<receipt-path>"}` to `goal prove`; design-alignment is semantic-only and cannot prove pixel fidelity

task.031.refuse_to_prove_visual_penflow_.description: Refuse to prove [visual]/[penflow] tasks `complete` while gate exit_code != 0 — "skipped due to missing prerequisites" est BLOCKED, jamais PASS

task.032.produce_structured_gap_report_s.description: Produce structured gap report (spec quality, FR table, AC table, Convention Compliance, summary)

task.033.include_convention_compliance_s.description: Include `Convention Compliance` section with domains checked, evidence, and convention gaps

task.035.add_check_entry_to_feature_chan.description: Add check entry to feature changelog.md

task.037.present_suggested_fixes_for_eac.description: Present suggested fixes for each gap with actionable commands

task.038.prompt_to_update_implementation.description: Prompt to update implementation.md status (or auto-update if --update)

task.040.create_missing_visual_penflow_p.description: Create missing visual/Penflow prerequisites required for an end-to-end fix attempt, or emit canonical BLOCKED with exact missing path/tool

task.045.write_actionable_warnings_for_a.description: Write actionable warnings for any remaining gap; emit canonical BLOCKED when no safe fix path exists

task.046.produce_consolidated_report_fea.description: Produce consolidated report: feature health table, cross-feature dependencies, aggregated stats, priority list

task.047.read_after_check_hooks_all_3_le.description: Read after-check hooks (all 3 levels: global, project, local)

visual.baseline_manifest.description: Run staleness gate: read baseline.manifest.yml, check browser version, check per-screen mockup SHA-256

visual.design_fidelity.description: Check design fidelity: compare VALID baselines vs mockup PNGs (5% threshold) [feature: 001-visual-check-fix]

visual.gate_validate.description: Capture fresh runtime PNGs to `.specs/features/<slug>/run/<run-id>/<target>/`, run `livespec visual-gate certify --feature <slug> --command spec-check --target <t> --run-id <run-id> --json`, then `livespec visual-gate validate --feature <slug> --command spec-check --target <t> --receipt <receipt-path> --json`

visual.gate_validate.058.description: For VISUAL features: `livespec visual-gate certify ... --command spec-check` produced a PASS receipt and `livespec visual-gate validate --feature <slug> --command spec-check --target <t> --receipt <receipt-path>` exited 0 ; exit 6/7 = step BLOCKED, no accepted proof

visual.pixel_regression.description: Run pixel regression via compareRegression() for each VALID baseline vs current screenshot [feature: 001-visual-check-fix]
